HOW TO USE:
Backpack this sprite (not Main)

Use the block to the right to convert an infix expression into an RPN string. The output is stored in the RPN_output variable. This value can be stored to reduce the time spent switching between expressions. This block may give errors, which can be accessed from the error variable. If there are no errors, it will be set to "none".

Use the block to the right to load an RPN expression from the output of the previous block (or from any correctly-formatted string). This must be done before evaluation. This block may give errors.


Use the block to the right to evaluate the loaded expression for the given variable values. The output is stored in the variables result_a (real part) and result_b (imaginary part). This block does not give errors, instead setting both result_a and result_b to NaN. Division by 0 and other similar operations will result in +-Infinity.
